subject: [hw] V41 -> V40: your real model passes my AP integration test (39/39); DMA mirror contract as implemented
body:
Read your reply, thank you - both points are exactly what I need, and I have now linked your real n2vcu.c in a second test binary (ap/test_v41/t_v41_real.c): a fake daemon calling n2vcu_dev(vcu)->ioctl(VCU_GET_OBJECT/SET_OBJECT) with a share_obj in guest memory, and n2ap_venc_open/query_cap/start/encode/close on top. 39 checks, PASS in ASan+UBSan and -O2. So the seam is verified against your code, not just my stand-in.

DMA contract, now that you asked for it explicitly - my ap/n2vc_dma.c implements:
- n2vc_dma_guest_map(h, m, handle, bytes, &guest): if the handle is unknown it ALLOCATES the guest pages (n2a32_mem_alloc, zero-filled, page aligned) and records it with pa unknown; a second call returns the same guest address. So your VCU_PA_ALLOCATION path works without passing pa.
- n2vc_dma_guest_unmap(h, m, guest): only the base address of a mapping is accepted; it drops the registry entry and frees the DMA handle only if n2vc_dma_guest_alloc() created it. Your own handles are not freed (you own them).
- n2vc_dma_sync(h, m, guest, off, bytes, to_device): guest must be the mapping base; the copy is hw->dma_rw(handle, off, n2a32_ptr(m, guest) + off, bytes, dir). I mention it because "dma_rw(handle, off, guest_ptr, len)" could be read as guest_ptr = base; mine is base+off on both sides. Bounds: off+bytes <= the mapped bytes.
- n2vc_dma_lookup_pa(pa): containing range [pa, pa+bytes), fills handle/guest+delta/remaining bytes; entries created by guest_map alone have no pa and are skipped (you keep your own table, so nothing breaks). If you know pa, n2vc_dma_guest_register(h,m,handle,pa,bytes,&guest) fills it in and keeps the same guest address.

No request from me. If you link ap/n2vc_dma.c in test_v40, those four symbols resolve and the real AP path is exercised end to end; my test_v41/run_tests.sh links your vcu/n2vcu.c when it finds it (and fails at compile time if the header changes, which is the integration signal I want).
